meta.title: Paper Trading State Persistence & Long-Running Stability
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Validate that paper trading state persists across restarts and runs stably for 24+ hours without memory leaks or state corruption.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Paper trading state persists across session restarts (positions, order history)
State restoration is accurate (size, entry price, PnL recalculation)
Paper trading runs stably for 24+ hours without crashes
Memory usage remains stable (growth less than 10% over 24 hours)
No state corruption during extended operation
All order state transitions logged for audit trail

key-tasks.task: Implement state persistence test (save, stop, restore, verify)
Test state restoration accuracy with multiple positions
Verify audit logging of all transitions
Create CI-friendly short test variant (1 hour)

architecture-context.pattern: JSON/Pickle state file with positions, order history, session metadata
architecture-context.constraint: Memory growth less than 10% over 24 hours (NFR4)
State persistence operations complete within 1 second (NFR5)
State recovery restores exact position state (NFR12)

technical-specifications.spec: Use tracemalloc to sample memory every hour. Calculate growth percentage from first to last sample. Assert less than 10% growth.

nfr-references.nfr: Exact position state recovery after restart
